verdict.rationale: Access review is a fair question for an identity and admin platform like Google Workspace, so the axis applies. The pack shows no certification campaigns, reviewer routing, or sign-off records. It only shows adjacent pieces: user listing via the Directory API, audit reports via the Reports API, and Apps Script automation. These are developer building blocks someone could use to build reviews, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a security engineer, access gets re-justified on a schedule — certification campaigns route who-has-what to reviewers and produce audit-ready sign-off records
